title: Apple Login doesn‘t work
body: The login via Apple doesn’t work, which is a shame for a app that’s supposed to be selected by Apple. When I click the button nothing happens. I can confirm the login with faceid, but then it gets stuck on the landing screen.
author: Robingla

title: Very helpful app
body: I recently came across this app that's been very helpful to me, I love the content and design 👍🏽 and to my biggest recent surprise, the founder is a great friend!
author: iMmah
